items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: Red Norvo was playing with his trio, with Tal Farlow and Charlie Mingus. And so I met him and they invited me to go down to Rochester with them.

ctx.x: Well actually it was a girl I guess originally, that sort of got me up there. I met this girl in Bermuda and we got pretty serious. And she left and I went up to see her. And I liked the

country and I didn’t feel I was ready for New York, you know. And whilst I was up there to visit this girl, at the Colonial Tavern, which is a very famous jazz club there, Red Norvo was playing with his trio, with Tal Farlow and Charlie Mingus. And so I met him and they invited me to go down to Rochester with them. Mingus was out of it then. He said, “Drive me down in my Cadillac.” I said, “Are you kidding?” I said, “I’ve never driven here.” “Oh you can do it, get in my Cadillac and drive.” I said, “But I don’t…
